hexcasting.page.almightly_staff.1: The $(item)Almightly Staff/$ appears as a book. it is a $(thing)grand unification/$ of all my hex-casting tools. It combines the multi-page iota storage of a $(l:items/spellbook)$(item)Spellbook/$, the scrying sight of a $(l:items/lens)$(item)Scrying Lens/$, and the casting interface of a $(l:items/staff)$(item)Staff/$ into a single implement.$(br2)With up to $(thing)sixty-four/$ pages, each capable of holding any iota, it also functions as a reusable spell-casting item.
hexcasting.page.almightly_staff.2: Using the staff is intuitive:$(br2)$(thing)Right-click/$ opens the familiar hex-casting grid, just like any $(l:items/staff)$(item)Staff/$. Iota can also be written directly in the usual manner, with pages turned by $(thing)sneak-scrolling/$ just as one would with a spellbook.$(br2)But the true power lies in the $(thing)V key/$. Once I have stored a spell, pressing $(k:almightly_staff.mode) instantly $(thing)casts/$ the iota on the active page;no fiddling with the grid required.
